name: Vixeo.io Host Resolver Plugin
description: Resolves third-party hosted video iframes from vixeo.io (and vidsonic.net) to direct HLS/MP4 streams.
author: TheDesiTadka Engine

steps: 2. Base64 decode data-config into UTF-8 JSON string
5. Convert two-character hex pairs into characters
6. Reverse string characters to obtain direct stream URL (e.g. index.m3u8 or video.mp4)
